row: Welcome to Dr. Kim's YouTube Channel HAPPYCARE. I am a veterinarian and PhD in biomedical science. I have been in the field for 8 years now and would like to share my knowlege and daily life with you. I'm gonna update you with my clinical cases, radiology reviews, surgery videos and how a typical day in the life of New York veterinarian goes. Also, in the near future, I will provide you useful tips and resources for studying and preparing for the exams and interviews. Stay tuned!
